تختلسوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِسُوا (taḵtalisū) /tax.ta.li.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# تُخْتَلَسُوا (tuḵtalasū) /tux.ta.la.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
